text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Ceramic and Bamboo Planter Flower Pot with Stand,14.5"H, Red and Orange
Colors: Coral/Orange
Materials: Ceramic
Eye-popping colors and a bamboo stand make this planter a true style standout, with or without an added house plant. Each is fired with reactive glaze and hand-painted, so no two are exactly alike. It's ideal for any room needing a bold style boost. 10.6"D x 10.6"W x 14.5"H Designed to hold house plants; does not have drainage holes Ceramic stoneware with separate bamboo stand Reactive glazing and hand-painting means no two are exactly alike in pattern and color
